findings: Cornerstone3D ViewportType.VOLUME_3D uses VTK volume actors under the hood. Its setProperties({ preset }) API natively accepts both built-in preset strings (e.g. 'CT-Bone') and custom ViewportPreset objects.
To avoid mouse binding conflicts with MPR CrosshairsTool on Primary LMB, the 3D volume viewport MUST use its own dedicated ToolGroup (volume3dToolGroupIdRef).

WebGL contexts in Cornerstone3D can be lost or zeroed if DOM elements are unmounted or set to display: none without dimensions. By keeping both the 3D Volume canvas container and the Planning panel mounted in DOM via display: flex/none and invoking renderingEngine.resize() on tab switch, WebGL context and volume actors remain fully intact.

Window resizing and container dimension changes are actively observed via ResizeObserver and window 'resize' listener, triggering renderingEngine.resize() and viewport.render() to prevent aspect ratio distortion or canvas stretch.
